newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan insurance premiums up 18.7 pct - Fenaseg.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan insurance premiums up 18.7 pct - Fenaseg.

text.p: Brazil's insurance premiums jumped 18.7 percent in January to 1.5 billion reais ($1.4 billion) compared to the same month in 1996, said Brazil's National Federation of Insurance Firms (Fenaseg) in a statement.
Fenaseg gave no reason for the surge in premiums.
It also said insurance premiums grew by an average 4.4 percent last year to 15.5 billion reais.
In January, vehicle insurance accounted for 30.4 percent of total premiums, while health and life insurance accounted for 21.9 percent and 18.1 percent respectively, it added.
